message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.gaunt: The snow has gone quiet. Something tall is standing between the trees, and it is looking at you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.cursed: Something cold settles in your belly and does not leave.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.cured: The hollow in you fills. You can breathe again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.grown: You are huge, and you are not hungry. Not yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.spent: The strength drains out of you. You are small again, and empty.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.stage.1: Your stomach turns over. Bread does not help.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.stage.2: Your hands shake. You keep thinking of the last thing you killed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hunger.stage.3: The edges of the world go dark. You would eat anything, if it were still warm.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.gaunt.ti: The Thin Thing in the Snow
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.gaunt.te: Something tall and thin was seen near %s, %s, standing outside the firelight. Folk who saw it up close do not eat well now. Kill it at night.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.gaunt: Last a night near %s, %s, where the thin thing was seen, and live to see the sun. Keep your fire small.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.gaunt.0: Don't light a fire in the snow, %1$s blocks %2$s. Something comes to the light. Tall. It doesn't blink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.gaunt.1: The trappers %1$s blocks %2$s say they saw antlers over the tree line. Over it. No stag stands that tall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.gaunt.2: A man came back from %1$s blocks %2$s with a bite on his arm and no appetite. Went off his food. Then he started looking at the dogs.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.none.2: People say it is bad luck to cook in the snow after dark. I just keep to the hearth.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.none.3: My grandmother never let us eat spoiled meat outdoors in winter. She never said why.
